title: BNPL Platinum: Purchase Protection Coverage, Limits, and Eligibility Window
summary: BNPL Platinum purchase protection coverage explains how reimbursements are calculated for covered losses, including the reimbursement-rate formula and caps. It also lists the per-item maximum, annual (per account, per calendar year) maximum, the claim eligibility window after purchase, and the need to submit documentation before approaching the annual cap.
